title: Three lanthanide complexes with mixed salicylate and 1,10-phenanthroline: syntheses, crystal structures, and luminescent/magnetic properties

material_class.structural_family: linear trinuclear salicylate–phenanthroline cluster assembled into a 3-D hydrogen-bonded supramolecular network

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Ho2O3 (0.2 mmol, 0.076 g), HSA (1.5 mmol, 0.207 g), phen (0.4 mmol, 0.079 g), and H2O (15 mL) was placed in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel, heated to 140 °C for 72 h, and cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1. Single crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained, collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal synthesis in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystals collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air

properties.summary: Variable-temperature dc susceptibility of crushed crystalline 1 is typical of three weakly interacting/isolated Ho(III) ions: χT = 43 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, decreasing to 23 cm3 K mol−1 below 50 K from depopulation of Stark sublevels. Magnetization reaches 16.1 μB at 1.8 K and 5 T, below the expected Ho3 saturation, attributed to anisotropy and crystal-field effects.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, applied field 0.3 T (crushed crystalline sample)

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: low T (sharp decrease below 50 K; data 2–300 K at 0.3 T)

material_class.structural_family: isostructural linear trinuclear salicylate–phenanthroline cluster (same as 1)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same hydrothermal method as 1 except that Ho2O3 was replaced by Er2O3 (0.2 mmol, 0.077 g). A mixture of the oxide, HSA (1.5 mmol, 0.207 g), phen (0.4 mmol, 0.079 g), and H2O (15 mL) was heated at 140 °C for 72 h in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel and cooled at 5 °C h−1. Crystals were collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal synthesis in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystals collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air

properties.summary: Solid-state photoluminescence of 2 at room temperature shows characteristic Er(III) near-infrared emission at 1540 nm (4I13/2 → 4I15/2) upon 340 nm excitation.

measurements.name: emission maximum
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 340 nm; 4I13/2 → 4I15/2

material_class.structural_family: binuclear salicylate–phenanthroline cluster linked by hydrogen bonds into a 3-D supramolecular network

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same hydrothermal method as 1 except that Ho2O3 was replaced by Sm2O3 (0.2 mmol, 0.070 g). A mixture of the oxide, HSA (1.5 mmol, 0.207 g), phen (0.4 mmol, 0.079 g), and H2O (15 mL) was heated at 140 °C for 72 h in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel and cooled at 5 °C h−1. Crystals were collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal synthesis in a 23 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystals collected by filtration, washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air

properties.summary: Solid-state emission of 3 at room temperature under 340 nm excitation shows four characteristic Sm(III) bands at 565, 599, 646, and 701 nm assigned to 4G5/2 → 6HJ (J = 5/2, 7/2, 9/2, 11/2).

measurements.name: emission maxima
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 340 nm; 4G5/2 → 6HJ (J = 5/2, 7/2, 9/2, 11/2)
